Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses Chemical Cross-Linking Mass Spectrometry (CLMS) with EDC/Sulfo-NHS. While not a traditional PTM enrichment, CLMS is routed via complexome/interactome modifiers (mod_tpp is the closest proxy for structural/interaction proteomics in the provided modifier list). Acquisition is DDA based on the 'high/high' Orbitrap strategy described.

organism: All protein complexes were expressed in E. coli strain BL21 Gold
scope: the protein complexes were purified by affinity chromatography in batch mode using glutathione sepharose (GE healthcare) beads
the gel bands of cross-linked complexes were processed following standard procedures and digested peptides were desalted using C18 StageTips

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis (CLMS) was performed on recombinant human Ska complexes purified from E. coli using affinity chromatography.
